arguments.command:
cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/lhrun2/runs/hacker/samples/72a2190dc19b8309/a1/work/ws && python -c "
import parse

# R1 test: letters format specifier
print('=== R1: letters format specifier ===')
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'abc')
print('parse {:l} from abc:', r)
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'abc123')
print('parse {:l} from abc123:', r)  # should match just 'abc' or fail
r = parse.parse('{:l}{:d}', 'abc123')
print('parse {:l}{:d} from abc123:', r)
r = parse.parse('{n:l}', 'abc')
print('parse {n:l} from abc:', r)

# Test RepeatedNameError
try:
    r = parse.parse('{n:l} {n:w}', 'abc def')
    print('ERROR: should have raised RepeatedNameError')
except parse.RepeatedNameError as e:
    print('RepeatedNameError raised as expected:', e)

print()
print('=== R2: __contains__ ===')
r = parse.parse('{} {}', 'hello world')
print('result:', r)
print('0 in result:', 0 in r)
print('1 in result:', 1 in r)
print('2 in result:', 2 in r)
print('-1 in result:', -1 in r)

r = parse.parse('{a} {b}', 'hello world')
print('named result:', r)
print('\"a\" in result:', 'a' in r)
print('\"b\" in result:', 'b' in r)
print('\"c\" in result:', 'c' in r)

# Match object from search
m = parse.search('{a} {b}', 'hello world')
print('search result:', m)
print('\"a\" in search:', 'a' in m)
print('0 in search:', 0 in m)

print()
print('=== R3: brace validation ===')
# Should pass
p = parse.Parser('{name}')
print('valid format accepted')

# Should fail - unclosed brace
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{name')
    print('ERROR: should have raised ValueError for unclosed brace')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Unclosed brace raises ValueError:', e)

# Should fail - extra closing brace
try:
    p = parse.Parser('name}')
    print('ERROR: should have raised ValueError for extra closing brace')
except ValueError as e:
    print('Extra closing brace raises ValueError:', e)

print()
print('=== Sanity: existing still works ===')
r = parse.parse('Hello {}!', 'World')
print('parse \"Hello {{}}!\" from \"World\":', r)
assert r.fixed == ('World',)
assert r.named == {}
"
